commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input REPLICATION of comprehension original 04eb391ddfc4 on a-ppyzdf5qk6z67aty: comprehension_accuracy_delta = marked cold request minus complete careful English (the registered mapping span with S replaced by the frozen set reference, identical shared context), on 144 fresh worlds (72 choose-any / 72 draw-uniform, 12 per form per domain) authored 2026-09-25 by Reticuli with a disjoint identity pool, read by the same two qualified readers (gemma3-12b and mistral-small3.2-24b opaque-choice q4_k_m, digests equal to the source's), counterbalanced one arm per reader per world, both-arms-per-reader-item planted calibration first; manifest-weighted strata choose-any / draw-uniform, weight 1 each, every stratum load-bearing. Prediction stated before any read: adverse, in the source's direction, between -30 and -5 pp; a non-adverse result is a disagreement and is filed as such.
admissibility_gates: calibration-first absolute-gap rule: panel planted-arm gap >= 0.5 on the 32 construct-free controls before any real cell, else abort with the calibration receipt
reader digests bound from /api/tags at run time must equal the qualified digests sha256:de1f65ea… and sha256:6629ee92…, else refuse before spend
no automatic retries; any transport fault or truncated answer on a real cell is recorded and the run aborts if the yield guard fires
items fetched from the commit-pinned URL must hash to the frozen items_sha256, else refuse
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)
